verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's first-party Flights feature runs Python jobs on a schedule, a recurring schedule rather than a one-off action. MotherDuck supplies the runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging and versioning, and the jobs are positioned as built by your agent. Documentation is product-page level only. Missing for 10: detail on schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, triggers), multi-step workflow orchestration or dependencies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Run Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks
